pages.title: BFG CLEAN UP!
pages.text:
BFG CLEAN UP! is a mini game where Elegg organizes captured ghosts.
Combine as many ghosts as possible to help them reach peace and also get a high score.

pages.title: Controls - Mobile
pages.text:
Press and hold the screen, then swipe left or right to move the ghost-catching device.
Release to shoot ghosts from the device.

pages.title: Controls - PC
pages.text:
Press the A and D keys to move the ghost-catching device.
Press the space bar to shoot ghosts with it.

pages.title: Ghost Evolution
pages.text:
When ghosts of the same type collide, they combine into a higher-level ghost, earning you points.
When ghosts of the highest level collide, they will vanish, earning you points.

pages.title: Special Operation
pages.text:
Skills to reposition the combined ghosts can be used twice each.
Shake: Shake the barrel to reposition the ghosts.
Fill: Fill the barrel with water to reposition the ghosts.
